title: Penn State Announces New Artificial Intelligence Grants For Faculty
script:
Penn State just announced new artificial intelligence grants for faculty.
The funding aims to support the integration of artificial intelligence into teaching and learning across campus.
Faculty members can now apply for financial backing on their projects.
Selected projects will integrate generative artificial intelligence into teaching and learning.
Onward State reported the announcement directly from University Park.
Would you take a class taught with this artificial intelligence support?
